Simulate event counts from the VE model

Source: R/stan.R
simulate_counts.Rd

Replaces the outcome in Stan input with Poisson counts generated under known parameters, keeping the real covariate structure. Used to check that fit_ve() recovers known values.

Usage

simulate_counts(stan_data, log_beta, gamma, seed = NULL)

Arguments

stan_data

Output of make_stan_data(), or its data element.

log_beta

True log transmission scaling.

gamma

True log hazard ratio per bin (length T_vax; element 1 is the unvaccinated bin and is ignored).

seed

Optional random seed, applied locally.

Value

stan_data (same form as supplied) with Y replaced.
